ui.fixture.about-description.text: NevroTick is a Windows timekeeping project designed for clear clock status and secure synchronization using NTP and Network Time Security (NTS).

ui.fixture.about-stage.text: Early development: time synchronization is not yet available.

ui.fixture.version-value.text: Development snapshot · no stable release declared

ui.fixture.technologies-description.text: Written in Rust. Slint provides the native interface; garde validates input. Serde and serde_json support strict localization source decoding. The separate engine pilot uses Tokio. Timekeeping integration is still in development.

ui.fixture.chrony-note.text: The timekeeping algorithms draw on chrony 4.9. It is an upstream source of code and ideas, not a linked runtime library.

ui.fixture.privacy-description.text: This preview collects no diagnostics or telemetry. Opening the repository uses your default browser. The planned application specifies no automatic telemetry or crash upload.

ui.fixture.artwork-description.text: Copyright David Osipov. NevroTick artwork and visual brand: all rights reserved. Visual assets are licensed separately from the application source code.

ui.source.protocol-help.text: Choose the protocol explicitly. Unavailable NTS never switches to plain NTP automatically.

ui.source.ntp-warning.text: Plain NTP does not authenticate the server response. This is an explicit local protocol preview.

ui.source.port-help.text: Decimal port from 1 to 65535. Defaults: NTS-KE 4460; NTP 123. A manually edited port stays unchanged when switching protocol.

ui.source.statistics-description.text: The local source preview contains identities and protocol-specific ports, without offsets, uncertainties or measurement history.

ui.recovery.description.text: Recovering a certificate-date basis and changing the Windows clock are separate operations.

ui.recovery.settings-description.text: Signed-date recovery details and optional, off-default plain-NTP helper previews open in Power user. Back returns to this Settings view and mode.

ui.recovery.context-description.text: Date-recovery helpers are separate from ordinary synchronization sources and supply no normal-selection votes.

ui.recovery.leave-description.text: Keep the raw fields for later, discard unsubmitted edits, or stay here. The retained local preview, active policy and services remain unchanged.

ui.recovery.roughtime-description.text: Roughtime supplies a signed approximate date when an incorrect computer date prevents secure NTS checks. Usable retained or strict NTS paths take priority; healthy tracking needs no periodic Roughtime checks.

ui.recovery.no-effect.text: A signed date alone cannot change your clock. Full NTS verification, fresh source agreement and separate clock authority are still required.

ui.recovery.unavailable.text: No live recovery evidence is connected in this preview.

ui.recovery.retained-step.text: 1. Try usable retained or strict NTS paths first.

ui.recovery.date-step.text: 2. When needed, verify Roughtime signatures and admit the approximate-date evidence separately.

ui.recovery.nts-step.text: 3. Verify NTS in isolation, retaining name, trust and revocation checks.

ui.recovery.agreement-step.text: 4. Obtain fresh agreement. Date-recovery sources supply no ordinary synchronization votes.

ui.recovery.authority-step.text: 5. Revalidate clock authority. No preliminary clock change is made.

ui.recovery.helpers-description.text: Off by default. These optional, unauthenticated helpers supply only a certificate-date hint. They are separate from signed Roughtime, never an automatic fallback, and do not authenticate time or vote in normal time selection.

ui.recovery.one-helper-warning.text: One helper provides a weaker, unauthenticated date hint.

ui.recovery.two-helper-warning.text: Both helpers must reply and agree; there is no silent fallback to one. Agreement still does not authenticate the date.

ui.recovery.host-help.text: ASCII hostname or IP address, without a URL, path or spaces. Helpers use NTP port 123.

ui.recovery.off.text: Helpers are off in this preview.

ui.recovery.boundary.text: This is an in-memory preview. Active policy and services remain unchanged.

ui.recovery.apply-unavailable.text: Applying helper settings requires the installed application's authorized management interface, which is not connected.

ui.shell.unknown-consequence.text: Quitting closes only the app observer. It does not stop services or confirm whether they are running or stopped.

ui.shell.draft-loss.text: This includes source, profile and helper previews, unfinished edits, the selected preview interval, and notification, tray and sign-in choices. They are not saved after this preview exits and have not been applied to Windows or the services.

ui.shell.observer-consequence.text: New local notifications stop when the last NevroTick window or tray observer exits. Background timekeeping is separate.

ui.shell.disable-path.text: To prevent future starts: Settings > Background service > Disable NevroTick.

ui.shell.separate-management.text: Managing a service opens its settings. Stopping, disabling or changing time management requires a separate authorized operation.

ui.shell.startup-note.text: The current startup configuration is not observed. Changing autostart would not start or stop an already running service.

ui.shell.disable-note.text: Disable NevroTick is a separate stop and future-start prevention operation. It requires confirmed clock cleanup and supported installed management.

ui.shell.handover-note.text: Changing the time manager is unavailable here. The installed application must reconcile ownership and perform a separate authorized handover. A running service alone does not prove synchronization.

ui.policy.description.text: Compare an explicit local profile preview with the unchanged fixture baseline.

ui.policy.nts-consequence.text: Only eligible NTS-authenticated sources may supply ordinary votes. Authentication alone does not establish agreement.

ui.policy.ntp-consequence.text: Plain NTP is unauthenticated. NTP and NTS sources do not vote together, and there is no automatic downgrade or fallback.

ui.policy.observe-consequence.text: Observe only authorizes no product clock writes. It does not turn on Windows Time or settle the acquisition and authentication mode.

ui.policy.authority.text: A real change needs a current policy revision and a specific administrator-authorized operation. This local preview simulates neither UAC nor activation.

ui.policy.apply-unavailable.text: Profile activation is unavailable: no protected Apply transaction is connected.

ui.policy.fixture-note.text: The NTS fixture baseline is sample data, not a declaration of a shipped default.

ui.diagnostic.correction-rule.text: A real proposal must be bound to fresh authenticated evidence, agreement, current policy and clock generation. An expired or changed proposal cannot be approved. Moving the clock can affect timestamps and running applications.

ui.status.detail.unavailable.text: Current synchronization is unconfirmed. A missing status connection does not establish that services stopped. Inspect diagnostics for the available facts.

ui.status.detail.waiting.text: Waiting for fresh admissible evidence. A running service or a reply alone does not establish synchronization.

ui.status.detail.tracking.text: The reported current policy is met. Authentication does not guarantee UTC accuracy; clock effects remain separate observations.

ui.status.detail.holdover.text: The owner reports the previous model is still usable. No fresh agreement is available; uncertainty and model limits remain important.

ui.status.detail.withheld.text: This status grants no new clock correction. Review the current prerequisite and evidence before continuing.

ui.status.detail.stopped.text: Stopped services cannot perform a fresh time check. Startup configuration, clock cleanup and Windows Time remain separate facts.

ui.status.detail.windows-managed.text: NevroTick does not control the clock in this reported mode. Windows Time ownership does not establish verified synchronization.

ui.status.detail.review.text: Review a current proposal separately. A check, opening this page or dismissing a notification cannot approve a clock change.

ui.status.detail.uncertain-result.text: Reconcile the actual result and clock ownership before repeating the operation. No outcome or cleanup is assumed.

ui.status.detail.rate-limited.text: The reported request limit remains in force. Reopening this window does not reset it; no retry duration is invented here.

ui.status.detail.date-recovery.text: Provisional date recovery does not change Windows time or establish authenticated tracking. Full verification and fresh agreement are still required.
